info.description: A user-marked A/B loop region on a Video, with the discovered key signature and chord progression. Created during play-along discovery on the Theory tab: pick a key by ear, then tap diatonic chord chips against the loop to capture the progression. `key` and `progression` are stored as JSON so the visualizer's ScaleSelection / ChordSelection shapes can round-trip without flattening. `melody` is reserved for v3.

key.description: ScaleSelection-shaped: { root: PitchClass, type: ScaleType }. Optional — null until the user picks a key.

progression.description: Ordered list of chord entries discovered against the loop. Each entry: { root: PitchClass, quality: ChordQuality, durationBeats: number | null }. v1 leaves durationBeats null (chords are an unordered-in-time sequence); v2 fills it in for synced playback.

melody.description: Reserved for v3. Null in v1/v2.

bpm.description: Optional tempo. Filled in if the user knows or estimates it. Used by v2 progression playback to convert beats → seconds.

notes.description: Free-form plain-text notes about this loop (what the section is, what the user is trying to play, etc.).
